text:
Situation: Ertapenem 1 g injection is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 448 vials (30 days on hand at 14.9 vials/day). Corvale General holds two lots totaling 722 vials (21.7 days on hand at 33.2 vials/day combined).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows ertapenem is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A registered manufacturing plant for ertapenem is ACS Dobfar SpA (FEI 3006028606) in Italy. Its most recent inspection ended 2024-12-13 and received a VAI classification. That plant has a history including an OAI classification in 2016 and a Warning Letter in 2017, but subsequent inspections in 2017, 2018, 2022, and 2024 were classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory covers 21–30 days across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Multiple suppliers not on the shortage list are available, though their labels name no identifiable plant. The known registered plant has an acceptable recent inspection history.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. as top-ranked option; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify BluePoint Laboratories and Dr.Reddys Laboratories Inc. as secondary sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate ENDO USA, Inc. and Eugia US LLC for additional supply diversity; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes; requires Pharmacy Manager approval.

Not recommended: No allocation or conservation measures at this time.
